Spanish 21 it is. We start with 1,000 chips.

The deck is 48 cards with every 10 removed, so face cards stay. A player 21 always beats the dealer's 21, and player blackjack beats dealer blackjack. Bonus payouts apply to a 21 made with five or more cards and to 6-7-8 or 7-7-7. You can double after split and surrender late. Otherwise it plays like regular blackjack.

Set your bet and deal when you're ready.
